name: antoine-personal
description: Gap coverage beyond cc-safety-net built-ins; partial port of the retired pre-bash-security.sh.
author: antoine

rules.name: block-npm-global-install
rules.reason: Global installs mutate the shared toolchain. Use a project-local dependency or mise.

rules.name: block-npm-package-publication
rules.reason: Package publication is irreversible. Do it manually.

rules.name: block-curl-file-upload
rules.reason: Uploading local file contents to a remote host is an exfiltration vector.

rules.name: block-wget-post-file
rules.reason: Posting local file contents to a remote host is an exfiltration vector.

rules.name: block-netcat-exec
rules.reason: Netcat exec creates a reverse shell.

rules.name: block-chmod-world-writable
rules.reason: World-writable permissions are rarely intended. Scope the mode down.
